question: Which of the following countries is a part of ‘I2U2' Summit?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India, Israel, UAE and US.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India, Israel, UAE and US** are the countries that are part of the **I2U2 summit.**
 
• The I2U2 summit is a quadrennial meeting of the foreign ministers of **India, Israel, UAE, and the US.**
 
• The first I2U2 summit was held in **2018 in New Delhi, India.**
 
• The **'West Asian Quad'** was another name for I2U2.
 
• Following the **Abraham Accords,** I2U2 was established in **October 2021** to address issues relating to** marine security, infrastructure, and transportation.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Important Summit Details:**

 
 
• UAE announced plans to invest **USD 2 billion in India** to build** Food Parks** all around the nation.
 
• India would contribute suitable land for the initiative and will make it easier for **farmers **to join the Food Parks.
 
• The Grouping announced that it will support a** "hybrid renewable energy project" in Gujarat **that would have a **300 MW capacity** for wind and solar energy.
 
• The project is anticipated to be another milestone in India's pursuit of **"500 GW of non-fossil fuel capacity by 2030".**
 
• The US and Israeli private sectors will be invited to contribute their **knowledge and creative ideas** that boost the general sustainability of the Grouping's undertakings.
 
 
 
• **Uganda **is **no**t part of the **I2U2 summit**, and there is no official collaboration between Uganda.
 
• **Iraq and Iran **are **not** part of the I2U2 summit, and their **geopolitical tensions** with the US and UAE make their inclusion unlikely.
